tax.text: He proposes rolling back parts of the 2025 tax law that cut taxes for billionaires.
tax.quote: Roll back portions of the 2025 tax law that added as much as $4 trillion to the debt to cut taxes for the billionaires.

housing.text: Davis supports creating affordable housing opportunities for working families.
housing.quote: Build and create affordable housing opportunities — prioritize housing that working families can actually afford,

schools.text: Davis supports strengthening public education for Louisiana students.
schools.quote: An effective Department of Education that serves every child — one that strengthens public education and, above all, stands up for the 1 in 7 Louisiana kids who count on an IEP and the families behind them.

immigration.text: He supports border security while also favoring an accessible path to citizenship.
immigration.quote: Davis said he supports securing the border, while also saying he does not want a path to citizenship to be overly burdensome.

abortion.text: Davis supports codifying Roe and keeping government out of abortion decisions.
abortion.quote: We should restore women’s right to healthcare, trust them as the mothers to make important family and personal decisions, codify Roe, and keep the government out of their business.

health.text: Davis supports expanding health coverage to everyone in Louisiana.
health.quote: Expand coverage to everyone in Louisiana with fair pay for the doctors and nurses who care for us.

energy.text: He supports Louisiana workers building the energy transition.
energy.quote: Louisiana energy workers should build what comes next, not be left out of it.

voting.text: He supports voter identification but also argues for expanded voting access and criticizes policies that make voting harder.
voting.quote: When asked whether voters should have to identify themselves to vote, Davis said yes, while also arguing for expanded access.

tax.text: Her Senate plan calls for extending the Trump tax cuts and making tax exemptions for tips and overtime permanent.
tax.quote: It's time to bring costs down and help families keep more of what they earn.

wages.text: She signed a congressional letter urging the Labor Department to withdraw its proposed $15 minimum wage requirement for federal contractors.
wages.quote: We are concerned that mandating a $15 minimum wage for federal contractors will destroy jobs and hurt small businesses.

schools.text: She says she will continue fighting for school choice and educational freedom.
schools.quote: I'll continue fighting for school choice, parents' rights, transparency in education and protecting girls' sports and opportunities for the next generation.

safety.text: She made border security and public safety her first priority and called for deportations, fentanyl enforcement and support for law enforcement.
safety.quote: First, border security and public safety. We must make President Trump's border policies permanent, deport criminal illegal aliens, stop fentanyl and support law enforcement.

sentencing.text: She supports the death penalty for the most heinous crimes.
sentencing.quote: I support the death penalty for the most heinous crimes. There are evil acts so horrific that the ultimate punishment is justified.

immigration.text: Her plan calls for finishing the border wall, deporting criminal undocumented immigrants, ending catch-and-release, and requiring nationwide E-Verify.
immigration.quote: America is a nation of laws, and no nation can remain sovereign without secure borders.

guns.text: She supports expanding concealed carry and opposes burdensome fees on gun owners.
guns.quote: I have consistently supported legislation to protect the rights of law-abiding gun owners, including expanding concealed carry and eliminating burdensome fees.

abortion.text: She describes herself as pro-life and says she has opposed taxpayer funding for abortion and supported legislation defending the unborn.
abortion.quote: I am unapologetically pro-life. As a mother, I believe every life is precious and worth protecting.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Her plan supports keeping transgender girls and women out of women's sports and codifying protections for women's athletics under Title IX.
gender.quote: Girls deserve a level playing field, and parents deserve confidence that common sense still matters in America.

cannabis.text: She voted against the MORE Act, which would have legalized and regulated cannabis federally.
cannabis.quote: Roll Call 107 | Bill Number: H. R. 3617

energy.text: Her plan calls for expanding oil and natural gas production, reversing anti-energy regulations, and protecting Louisiana energy jobs.
energy.quote: Louisiana powers America. We should be leading the world in energy production instead of begging foreign countries for resources we already have.

voting.text: Her plan calls for proof of citizenship in federal elections, stronger voter ID requirements, and cleaning up voter rolls.
voting.quote: Louisianans deserve confidence that every legal vote counts and that elections are secure, transparent, and trustworthy.
